scenario_description: Insufficient evidence for any root-cause conclusion: every telemetry source was reachable but returned no data relevant to the incident, so the (real, validated) report survives with zero observations and zero hypotheses. classify_investigation must report 'inconclusive', never fabricate a hypothesis merely to have something to say.

provenance.notes: Models a real 'no_data' outcome across all telemetry sources (investigator_service.domain.evidence.CollectionStatus='no_data') -- an honest empty result, not an error.

ground_truth_rationale: classify_investigation's own first rule is exact: 'if not observations and not hypotheses: return inconclusive'. A report with nothing citable must be labeled exactly that -- never upgraded to 'partial' or 'well_supported' merely because the incident itself is real and severe.

missing_evidence.description: no telemetry source returned data correlating with this incident's reported window

suggested_checks.description: manually inspect payment-service's own dashboards for this window
suggested_checks.rationale: automated evidence collection found nothing conclusive

forbidden_outcomes: any hypothesis invented to fill the gap when no real evidence exists
